author: Josan
description: A classic Indian spiced buttermilk, flavored with roasted cumin, ginger, and herbs — cooling and perfect for digestion.
instructions: In a blender, add yogurt, cold water, roasted cumin powder, grated ginger, salt, and black salt.
Add chopped coriander, mint leaves, and green chili.
Stir gently and pour into glasses.
Garnish with a sprinkle of cumin powder or a mint leaf.
